name: t01-papel
title: T01 · captura do papel real do comprovante (sem voz)

steps.js: (async()=>{const n0=window.__n0||0;let n=-1,parado=0;for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const k=(window.__pdfs||[]).length;if(k>n0&&k===n){if(++parado>=3)break}else parado=0;n=k;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250))}const b=window.__pdfs&&window.__pdfs.length>n0&&window.__pdfs[window.__pdfs.length-1];if(!b)return 'SEM PDF';const u=new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer());let s='';for(let i=0;i<u.length;i+=8192)s+=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,u.subarray(i,i+8192));return {nome:'A',pdfs:window.__pdfs.length,bytes:u.length,b64:btoa(s)}})()
steps.label: captura A

steps.js: (()=>{const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('main label')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Mostrar só peso líquido');if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';let c=el;while(c&&c!==document.body){const b=c.querySelector('button[role=switch]');if(b){b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});b.click();return 'clicou: '+b.getAttribute('aria-checked')}c=c.parentElement}return 'SEM SWITCH'})()
steps.label: liga peso líquido
